mentions.name: Lynx
mentions.description: A fully customizable, open-source AI workspace designed as a primary working environment, with the author doing most of their work from inside it.
mentions.source_excerpt:
My main side project at the moment is an AI workspace that's fully customizable.

I've done 80-90% of my work from inside it the past two weeks and made it open source, but haven't made much noise about it yet.

https://lynx.railcode.dev
